运.mnemonic: Walk (辶) with clouds (云): TRANSPORT across the sky. Yùn — yoon.

近.mnemonic: Walk (辶) with an axe (斤): NEAR the wood. Jìn — jin.

还.mnemonic: Not (不) walking (辶) away: STILL here. Hái — hi, still.

这.mnemonic: Walk (辶) up to the writing (文) and point: THIS one.

进.mnemonic: Walk (辶) to the well (井): ENTER. Jìn — jin.

远.mnemonic: Walk (辶) from the origin (元): FAR. Yuǎn — ywen.

送.mnemonic: Walk (辶) to the gate (关) to SEND off. Sòng — song.

道.mnemonic: Walk (辶) with your head (首) leading: the ROAD. Dào — dow.

那.mnemonic: That city over there (阝). Nah — not this one, THAT one.

都.mnemonic: Everyone in the city (阝): ALL of them. Dōu — doh, the whole lot.

里.mnemonic: Measure the field (田) in the soil (土): the village INSIDE the fields, a li across.

钟.mnemonic: Metal (钅) in the middle (中): a bell, a clock.

铅.mnemonic: Metal (钅) with a mouth (口): LEAD. Qiān — chyen.

错.mnemonic: Gold (钅) from the past (昔) is lost: a MISTAKE. Cuò — tswaw.

长.mnemonic: An old man with long hair: LONG. Cháng — chahng.

门.mnemonic: An open doorway: DOOR. Mén — mun.

问.mnemonic: A mouth (口) at the door (门): ASK. Wèn — wun.

间.mnemonic: The sun (日) in the doorway (门): BETWEEN, a room. Jiān — jyen.

阴.mnemonic: The moon's (月) place (阝): the shady, CLOUDY side. Yīn — yin.

院.mnemonic: A finished (完) place (阝): a walled courtyard.

雨.mnemonic: Drops falling from a cloud: rain.

雪.mnemonic: Rain (雨) you can sweep (彐): SNOW. Xuě — shweh.

零.mnemonic: Rain (雨) and a command (令): ZERO drops? Líng — ling.

非.mnemonic: Two wings back to back: NOT, opposed. Fēi — fay.

面.mnemonic: A face drawn around an eye: face, surface.

题.mnemonic: The head (页) of the matter (是): the TOPIC. Tí — tee.

颜.mnemonic: A head (页) with a pattern (彦): FACE, colour. Yán — yen.

飞.mnemonic: A bird flapping its wings: fly.

饭.mnemonic: Food (饣) turned (反) into a meal.

馆.mnemonic: Food (饣) in an official building (官): a HALL. Guǎn — gwahn.

鱼.mnemonic: A fish swimming upstream: FISH. Yú — yoo.

鸡.mnemonic: Another (又) kind of bird (鸟): CHICKEN. Jī — jee.

黑.mnemonic: A face blacked by fire (灬): BLACK. Hēi — hay.
